guard.note: five fresh 512 x 512 BufferedImages (TYPE_INT_ARGB data, TYPE_INT_RGB foliage / grass / water / blocks), one setRGB each per pixel in the order the redirect ordinals 0-4 name, then the map-thread lambda
the images are only PNG-encoded into the region zip (ImageIO.write), never drawn

ftbchunks_region_write_direct.conversion: @Redirect of each of the five BufferedImage.setRGB(III) calls in MapRegionData.write() to a handler per call site that stores the pixel into the image's DataBufferInt array (rgb for TYPE_INT_ARGB, rgb & 0xFFFFFF for TYPE_INT_RGB) after a once-per-image layout check (helper bons.furious.patch.ftbchunks_c49.RegionWriteDirect)

guard.note: hands the task to the map thread
collects changed block positions for the re-render tasks
the collected positions become ChunkUpdateTasks through queueOrExecute
every received chunk becomes a ChunkUpdateTask through queueOrExecute (claims do not pass here)
